info.title: Roadmap API
info.description:
Stable JSON API for the Roadmap project board and its built-in internal bug
tracker. Humans use a session cookie or Cloudflare Access identity; agents
use scoped bearer tokens.
Single-resource responses contain the resource directly. Collections use
a cursor-paginated object containing data and next_cursor. Collection
cursors are opaque URL-safe offsets and an empty next_cursor means that
there is no next page. Every response includes X-Request-ID; deployments
that provide a release revision also include X-Roadmap-Revision.
Cookie- and Cloudflare-authenticated mutations require an Origin that
exactly matches the configured public origin; bearer-token mutations do
not require Origin. Temporary bearer-authentication or request-body
admission saturation returns 503 with Retry-After.

patch.description:

enforce their declared length and format constraints.

Column created. Humans and bearer tokens with projects:read

patch.description:
An empty object or a body with no recognized column field returns 400.
Non-nullable properties reject explicit JSON `null`; string properties
enforce their declared length and format constraints. A human
administrator may explicitly override an active task claim when
changing a column's semantic state; bearer tokens and ordinary human
actors cannot.

200.description:
Updated column. Humans and bearer tokens with projects:read
receive the full column; a projects:write-only bearer receives
only its id and project_id.

409.description:
The column cannot change semantic state while a task in it has an
active claim. Humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read retain
diagnostic claim details; bearer tokens without tasks:read receive

get.description:
Results are ordered by column position and task position. `state`,
`column`, `kind`, `priority`, `severity`, `label`, `assignee`,
`reporter`, `resolution`, `agent_state`, `action_needed`, `q`, and
`updated_after` can be combined. `agent_state` filters the latest
structured agent-work snapshot; `stale` and `missing` identify
read-time liveness conditions. `action_needed=true` selects waiting,
handoff, or stale snapshots among unfinished tasks; completed tasks
retain their snapshot as history but never match an agent-work filter.
`action_needed=false` is accepted as an explicit no-op filter for
clients that build filters dynamically.
`state` filters by a column's semantic state. Supplied scalar filters
are single-valued; empty identifier/enum/timestamp values and values
outside their declared enum, format, or length are rejected with
`400`.

get.summary: List board-audit runs for a project
get.description:
Returns cursor-paginated audit-run metadata for the selected project.
This read-only operation requires `tasks:read`; it never changes a
task or applies a finding. Run detail contains only bounded summary
metadata; fetch findings through the separate findings collection.

post.description:
Creates a queued or running audit snapshot for the selected project.
Audit writes require `tasks:write`. Creating a run only records audit
metadata; it does not move, claim, update, or otherwise mutate tasks.
Send `Idempotency-Key` when retrying the request.

201.description: Audit run created; no task changes are made.

get.description:
Returns bounded run metadata and the finding count. The `findings`
array is always empty on this summary resource; use
`GET /api/v1/audits/{audit}/findings` for the paginated findings. This
operation is read-only and requires `tasks:read`.

get.summary: List findings for an audit run
get.description:
Returns the immutable, cursor-paginated observations captured by an
audit. Reading findings requires `tasks:read`; each response computes
`changed_since_audit` from the current task version and source column.
Reading findings never changes a task.

post.description:
Appends one immutable task observation while the run is queued or
running. Audit writes require `tasks:write`. The server validates the
captured task version and source column but never changes the task or
applies the recommendation. Repeating the same finding is idempotent
at the resource level; send `Idempotency-Key` for safe HTTP retries.

201.description: Finding appended; no task changes are made.

post.description:
Closes a queued or running audit with `complete`, `partial`, or
`failed`. Audit writes require `tasks:write`. Finalization changes
only audit-run lifecycle metadata; findings remain review-only and no
task move is applied. Send `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries.

200.description: Finalized audit-run summary; findings remain unchanged.

patch.description:
Updates only the finding review state and, when supplied, its proposed
semantic destination. Audit writes require `tasks:write`. The captured
task snapshot, captured version, source column, verdict, confidence,
reason, and evidence remain immutable. Supply the finding's strong
ETag as `If-Match`; use `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries. Reviewing a
finding never moves or otherwise changes its task. Approval is
accepted only after the run is finalized as `complete` or `partial`
and while the captured task version and source column still match.

200.description: Updated finding; no task changes are made.

get.description:
Agent-friendly global listing of bug tasks. Results are ordered by
project, column position, and task position and always have
`kind: bug`. An unscoped identity may search every project; a
project-scoped bearer token searches the union of its permitted
projects when `project` is omitted and can never receive issues
outside that project ceiling. An optional `project` narrows the
result to one permitted project. Requires `tasks:read`.
`severity=untriaged` and `resolution=unresolved` select bugs whose
corresponding lifecycle field is unset.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Restrict issues to a permitted project ID, key, or stable slug; omitted project-scoped tokens search their permitted project ceiling.

patch.description:
Update one or more editable fields. Movement is represented by column_id
and position. `kind` and nested `bug` details extend the task model;
when changing a task to a bug, supply the bug details required by the
bug lifecycle. An empty object or a body with no recognized task field
returns 400. Sending null for description, assignee (or assignee_id),
due_at, labels, or label_ids clears that nullable value; column_id,
column, position, title, priority, and kind are non-null fields. A
human administrator may explicitly override an active claim for this
operation; bearer tokens and ordinary human actors cannot.

200.description: Updated task; humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read receive the full task, while write-only bearer tokens receive only id/version metadata.

delete.description: Human administrators may explicitly override an active claim; bearer tokens and ordinary human actors cannot.

post.description:
Moves an unfinished task to a backlog or ready column only. Task
moves require `tasks:write`, the exact current task ETag in `If-Match`,
and an `Idempotency-Key`. The expected source column is guarded in the
same transaction as the task version and active-claim check; any live
claim, including the caller's own, rejects the move. The server
computes the destination position atomically, so `position` is not a
request field. A successful move emits a `task.moved` event. This is
the explicit apply step after a client has reviewed an audit finding;
audit reads and finding review never apply moves.

200.description: Moved task; the server allocated its destination position and emitted task.moved.

data.body: Progress is now visible in the event feed.

post.summary: Add a comment to a task
post.description:
Supply body or its text alias. When body is empty or omitted, text is
used; when both are non-empty, body wins. At least one non-empty value
is required. The response contains the canonical body field.

example.body: Progress is now visible in the event feed.

get.description:
Return the durable newest-first task activity stream, merging
structured agent progress, comments, and task-change events. The
response uses stable opaque keyset cursors: pass `next_cursor` as
`before` to load older activity. Generated progress comments and their
`comment.created` events are represented once by the corresponding
`agent_progress` item. Legacy comments and events remain available as
comments or generic `task_change` items without inferred progress
fields. Timeline reads require `tasks:read`.

progress.summary: Added the progress persistence and HTTP contract.

post.description:
Replace the task's live structured agent-work snapshot. The caller
must have `tasks:claim`, send the exact current task ETag in
`If-Match`, and hold the task's active claim. This is a complete
snapshot: omitted optional fields clear their previous values. The
mutation appends the progress event and its human-readable comment in
the same transaction. Reusing an Idempotency-Key with the same
authenticated principal, path, and request body replays the original
response without publishing a second snapshot, comment, or event.
`working`, `waiting`, `verifying`, and `handoff` are publishable states;
`stale` and `missing` are read-time filter states only.

example.summary: Added the progress persistence and HTTP contract.

200.description:
Updated task. Humans and bearer tokens with `tasks:read` receive
the full task, while bearer tokens without `tasks:read` receive
only `{id,version}`. The response includes the strong task ETag.

post.description:
Refresh only the `updated_at` liveness timestamp of the existing
agent-work snapshot identified by `operation_id`. The caller must
have `tasks:claim`, be allowed to access the task's project, own the
task's active unexpired claim, and match both the snapshot actor and
operation ID. The task must remain unfinished. Heartbeats are quiet
and inherently idempotent: they do not change the task version or
`tasks.updated_at`, replace any snapshot content, append comments or
events, reserve the agent mutation budget, or persist idempotency
records. `If-Match` is intentionally not required because the
heartbeat never changes task state or its optimistic-concurrency
version. `Idempotency-Key` is not supported; omit it.

200.description:
Task with the unchanged version and refreshed agent-work
timestamp. Humans and bearer tokens with `tasks:read` receive the
full task; bearer tokens without `tasks:read` receive only
`{id,version}` according to the normal mutation redaction. The
strong task ETag is unchanged.

post.description: Atomically claim an unclaimed or expired task for the current actor.

post.description:
Set the bug severity and optionally update its priority, assignee, or
column in one optimistic-concurrency mutation. This action applies to
bug tasks; ordinary tasks return `400`. Severity is independent of
task priority and is required even when the bug already has one.
Bearer callers need the `tasks:write` scope.

200.description: Bug triaged; humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read receive the full task, while write-only bearer tokens receive only id/version metadata.

post.description:
Resolve a bug with one of the documented resolutions. `duplicate_of`
is required when `resolution` is `duplicate` and must identify another
task in the same project. This action applies to bug tasks; ordinary
tasks return `400`. Bearer callers need the `tasks:write` scope.

200.description: Bug resolved; humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read receive the full task, while write-only bearer tokens receive only id/version metadata.

post.description:
Reopen a previously resolved bug and record the reason. Reopening
clears its resolution, resolved-by, resolved-at, and duplicate-of
details. This action applies to bug tasks; ordinary tasks return `400`.
Bearer callers need the `tasks:write` scope.

example.reason: The regression is reproducible on the current release.

200.description: Bug reopened; humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read receive the full task, while write-only bearer tokens receive only id/version metadata.

get.summary: List work assigned to the current actor
get.description:
By default, returns tasks assigned to the authenticated actor across
all projects, or across the requested project. Results include
assigned tasks and tasks with an active claim owned by the actor. Set
`view=live` for the coordination pulse view: it returns unfinished
tasks that have a structured agent-work snapshot, ordered with
action-needed pulses first. `view=assigned` is an explicit spelling of
the legacy actor-assignment and active-claim view. `agent_state` and
`action_needed` can be combined with either view. An unknown requested
project returns 404; a project-scoped token must name a project.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Restrict work to a project ID, key, or slug.

get.description:
Due-soon counts cover incomplete tasks due from now through the next
seven days. A project-scoped bearer token must supply the optional
`project` query parameter; without it this global aggregate returns 403.
Bearer tokens without tasks:read receive empty `upcoming` and
`upcoming_tasks` arrays; tokens without events:read receive an empty
`recent_activity` array. Project aggregates remain available with
projects:read.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Optionally restrict the summary to a project ID, key, or slug.

get.description:
Due-soon counts cover incomplete tasks due from now through the next
seven days. Bearer tokens without tasks:read receive empty `upcoming`
and `upcoming_tasks` arrays; tokens without events:read receive an empty
`recent_activity` array. Project aggregates remain available with
projects:read.

Supply `after` with the last integer cursor seen to receive subsequent
project, task, claim, comment, completion, and bug lifecycle events.
Agent progress publishes `task.progressed` events containing the
machine-readable state and checkpoint counts. Bearer tokens with
`events:read` but without `tasks:read` receive those coordination
fields with progress narrative (`phase`, `summary`, `next_action`,
and `checkpoint_refs`) redacted.
Bug lifecycle events (`bug.created`, `bug.updated`, `bug.triaged`,
`bug.resolved`, `bug.duplicated`, and `bug.reopened`) carry lifecycle
and version metadata and are emitted in the same transaction as the
action. Resolution events include the selected resolution; a reopen
reason is recorded in the atomic comment.created event associated with
the action.

parameters.description: Restrict events to a project ID, key, or slug.

cloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
cloudflareAccess.description:
Compact RS256 JWT assertion injected by a protected Cloudflare Access
Tunnel. The server validates its signature, issuer, expiration, and
configured UI/API application audience before using its signed email
claim. Generic reverse-proxy identity headers are never accepted.

ETag.description: Strong task or audit-finding version validator. Send this value as If-Match on the next mutation of that resource.

SetCookie.description: Session cookie update. Clients should honor its security attributes.

XRequestID.description: Request correlation identifier generated by the server or accepted from the client.

XRoadmapRevision.description: Deployed Git revision, when the server was started with a release revision.

ProjectPath.name: project
ProjectPath.description: Project ID, key, or stable slug.

TaskPath.name: task
TaskPath.description: Opaque task ID or project-local task key such as OPS-42; task keys are matched case-insensitively.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description:
Opaque cursor returned as next_cursor. Omit for the first page. For
collection routes this is a URL-safe base64 encoding of the next row
offset; a raw non-negative decimal offset is also accepted. An empty
next_cursor terminates pagination, but a supplied empty `cursor` is
invalid. Malformed, negative, or repeated values return 400. It is not
an event feed cursor.

BeforeTimelineCursor.name: before
BeforeTimelineCursor.description: Opaque item cursor returned by a prior timeline page. Omit for the newest page; malformed, empty, or repeated values are invalid.

TimelineKind.name: kind
TimelineKind.description: Restrict activity to one discriminated item kind.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of records to return; defaults to 50, rejects non-positive values with 400, and values above 200 are capped at 200.

AfterCursor.name: after
AfterCursor.description: Return events with a monotonic cursor greater than this value; supplied empty, negative, malformed, or repeated values are invalid.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-generated key for safely retrying a mutation. Reusing the same
key with the same authenticated principal, method, path, and payload
replays the original response before mutable resource lookup, including
after the resource has been deleted or changed. Bearer-token retries
are isolated by token credential, even when tokens belong to the same
agent actor. Location and ETag from the original response are replayed;
using it for another request returns 409 Conflict. Authentication
setup, login, and logout do not accept this header, and secret token
issuance rejects it so plaintext cannot be replay-cached.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description:
Exact last observed task or audit-finding ETag. The value must be
quoted as "vN" with N a positive decimal version. Missing If-Match
returns 428, malformed values return 400, and a stale task version
returns 409 with the current task in error.details.current (reduced to
id/version for bearer tokens without tasks:read).

TaskState.name: state
TaskState.description: Filter by the task column's semantic state.

ColumnFilter.name: column
ColumnFilter.description: Filter by column ID or case-insensitive column name.

SeverityFilter.name: severity
SeverityFilter.description: Filter by bug severity. Tasks without bug details do not match.

LabelFilter.name: label
LabelFilter.description: Filter by label ID or case-insensitive label name.

AssigneeFilter.name: assignee
AssigneeFilter.description: Filter by assignee actor ID. Use `none` for unassigned tasks.

ReporterFilter.name: reporter
ReporterFilter.description: Filter bug tasks by reporter actor ID.

ResolutionFilter.name: resolution
ResolutionFilter.description: Filter bug tasks by resolution; unresolved bugs have no resolution.

IssueSeverityFilter.name: severity
IssueSeverityFilter.description: Filter bug severity; use `untriaged` for bugs without a severity.

IssueResolutionFilter.name: resolution
IssueResolutionFilter.description: Filter bug resolution; use `unresolved` for bugs without a resolution.

SearchQuery.name: q
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive task title and description search; values longer than 200 characters are invalid.

UpdatedAfter.name: updated_after
UpdatedAfter.description: Return tasks updated after this UTC RFC 3339 timestamp.

AgentStateFilter.name: agent_state
AgentStateFilter.description:
Filter by the latest agent-work state. `working`, `waiting`,
`verifying`, and `handoff` are published states; `stale` and `missing`
are read-time liveness states. Completed tasks retain their snapshot
as history but never match this filter. Values are lowercase and
repeated or invalid values return 400.

ActionNeededFilter.name: action_needed
ActionNeededFilter.description:
Strict lowercase boolean. `true` selects unfinished waiting, handoff,
or stale agent-work snapshots; completed tasks never match. `false`
leaves the result unfiltered. Empty, malformed, or repeated values
return 400.

MyWorkView.name: view
MyWorkView.description:
Set to `live` for the coordination pulse view of unfinished tasks with
agent-work snapshots. Set to `assigned` or omit it to retain the
legacy actor-assignment and active-claim view. Empty, unsupported, or
repeated values return 400.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not supported for this route

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or credentials are invalid

Forbidden.description: Authenticated actor lacks permission or token scope

Conflict.description: Request conflicts with current state or idempotency history

StaleTask.description:
Task version is stale. Humans and tokens with tasks:read receive the
full current task in details.current; write-only and claim-only bearer
tokens receive only its id and version so read-protected fields are not
disclosed.

TaskMutationConflict.description:
Task mutation conflicts are either a stale task version, an active
claim held by another actor, or an idempotency key reused for a
different request. Human administrators may explicitly override an
active claim for task PATCH and DELETE; bearer tokens and ordinary
human actors cannot.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match was missing from a task mutation (HTTP 428).

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Readiness failed or a bounded authentication/body admission pool is temporarily full.

RequestTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the 2 MiB server limit.

InsufficientStorage.description: An agent's lifetime mutation resource budget is exhausted.

Identifier.description: Opaque identifier. Clients must not infer its format.

NullableTimestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when not applicable.

AuthMode.description: Authentication mode configured by the deployment.

ProjectMutationResponse.description: Full project for humans and projects:read tokens, or id-only metadata for projects:write-only bearer tokens.

AuditRun.description:
Bounded metadata for one board-audit run. The server returns
`findings: []` on this resource; findings are never expanded here and
must be fetched through the cursor-paginated findings collection.

findings.description: Always empty on the summary resource; use the findings collection for data.

AuditRunCreateRequest.description: Start a queued or running audit run. Creating it never mutates tasks.

scope.description: Opaque audit selection label, such as `board` or `open_tasks`.

status.description: Initial lifecycle state; omitted values default to `running`.

AuditFinding.description:
Immutable observation of one task at the time of an audit. The server
computes `changed_since_audit` at read time by comparing the current
task version and source column with this finding's captured values.

source_column.description: Opaque column ID captured by the auditor.

proposed_semantic_destination.description: Suggested semantic destination for a move proposal; omitted when none was captured.

evidence_refs.description: Safe, non-duplicated evidence identifiers without query strings, fragments, or executable/data URLs.

version.description: Finding review version used by If-Match.

changed_since_audit.description: True when the task version or source column differs from the captured snapshot.

AuditFindingCreateRequest.description:
Append one finding to a queued or running audit. Supply either
`source_column` or its accepted alias `source_column_id`; when both
are supplied they must match. `review_state` defaults to `pending`.
The server validates the snapshot but never changes the task.

proposed_semantic_destination.description: Required for `move_proposed`; forbidden for other verdicts.

evidence_refs.description: Safe, non-duplicated evidence identifiers without query strings, fragments, or executable/data URLs.

review_state.description: Findings always begin pending; approval and dismissal use the versioned review endpoint.

AuditFindingReviewRequest.description:
Change only review metadata. Omitting
`proposed_semantic_destination` preserves the existing suggestion;
sending null clears it. The captured task snapshot remains immutable.
Approval requires a `complete` or `partial` run and an unchanged task
snapshot.

proposed_semantic_destination.description: Optional replacement destination, or null to clear it.

AuditFindingMutationSummary.description: Reduced audit-finding mutation response for bearer tokens without tasks:read.

AuditFindingMutationResponse.description: Full finding for humans and tasks:read tokens, or id/version metadata for write-only bearer tokens.

TaskMoveRequest.description:
Guarded raw board move intent. Supply one or more agreeing aliases
from each destination/source group; canonical names are
`destination_column_id` and `expected_source_column_id`. `source` is
required provenance and `reason` is optional. The server assigns the
destination position atomically, so `position` and other fields are
rejected. Only backlog and ready destination columns are allowed.

source.description: Required bounded provenance label, for example `board_audit`.

reason.description: Optional bounded explanation; when supplied it must not be empty.

bug.description: Bug-specific details; omitted for ordinary tasks.

agent_work.description: Latest structured agent progress snapshot; omitted when no pulse has been published.

assignee.description: Assignee actor ID; omitted when unassigned.

claimed_by.description: Actor ID holding the current claim; omitted when unclaimed.

due_at.description: Due timestamp; omitted when no due date is set.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp; omitted until the task is completed.

AgentWork.description:
The latest complete agent progress snapshot for a task. `stale` is
derived when the snapshot has not been updated within the server's
liveness window. `action_needed` is true for waiting, handoff, or stale
snapshots. A completed task retains this snapshot as history while
both liveness flags are false. Checkpoint counts are either both
present or both omitted.

actor_id.description: Actor that published the latest snapshot.

AgentWorkPublishRequest.description:
Complete replacement snapshot for POST /api/v1/tasks/{task}/progress.
Optional properties omitted from the request clear their previous
values. Null is not accepted for any property. Checkpoint counts must
be supplied together and satisfy 0 <= checkpoint_completed <=
checkpoint_total <= 100; non-empty checkpoint_refs must have the same
length as checkpoint_total.

AgentWorkHeartbeatRequest.description:
Existing agent-work operation to keep alive. The heartbeat refreshes
only the snapshot's `updated_at` timestamp; null and unknown
properties are rejected.

BugDetails.description:
Details for a bug task. `actual_behavior` is required when a bug is
created; the remaining fields are filled during triage and resolution.
Unset fields are omitted. `severity` is nullable so a bug may be
explicitly returned to an untriaged state.

reporter_id.description: Actor who reported the bug; set from the authenticated actor on creation.

severity.description: Impact severity, from s1 (highest) to s4 (lowest), or null when untriaged.

expected_behavior.description: What the system should have done.

reproduction_steps.description: Steps or inputs needed to reproduce the bug.

affected_version.description: Application version known to be affected.

resolution.description: Resolution; omitted for an open bug and null when explicitly cleared.

resolved_by.description: Actor who resolved the bug; omitted until resolution.

duplicate_of.description: Task ID of the canonical bug when resolution is duplicate.

BugCreateDetails.description: Bug report fields accepted when creating a bug; reporter and lifecycle fields are server-managed.

BugPatchDetails.description: Partial bug report details merged by task PATCH; reporter and lifecycle fields are server-managed.

severity.description: Impact severity, or null to mark the bug untriaged.

TaskMutationSummary.description: Reduced task mutation response for bearer tokens without tasks:read.

TaskMutationResponse.description: Full task for humans and tasks:read tokens, or id/version metadata for bearer tokens without tasks:read. The ETag remains the strong task version validator.

TaskCreateRequest.description:
Create an ordinary task with `kind: task`, or an internal bug with
`kind: bug` and nested `bug` details. When kind is omitted it defaults
to `task` for compatibility. Bug creation requires
`bug.actual_behavior`; other bug fields may be added during triage and
resolution. The nested object is omitted for ordinary tasks.

column_id.description: Destination column; defaults to the project's backlog column.

column.description: Alias for column_id accepted by clients.

bug.description: Required when kind is `bug`; omitted for kind `task`.

TaskPatchRequest.description:
Patch ordinary task fields and, for bug tasks, merge fields in the
nested `bug` object. Omitted nested fields remain unchanged. The
`kind` field is optional because PATCH is partial.

description.description: Markdown description; null clears it to an empty string.

assignee_id.description: Assignee actor ID; null clears the assignee.

assignee.description: Alias for assignee_id; null clears the assignee.

bug.description: Partial bug details; only valid for bug tasks.

ClaimRequest.description: Lease duration is optional; omitted duration defaults to 1800 seconds. Explicit values are inclusive from 30 through 604800 seconds.

lease_seconds.description: Lease duration from the time the action is accepted.

reason.description: Optional Markdown explanation for blocking the task.

TriageRequest.description: Set bug severity and optionally update task routing fields.

assignee_id.description: Assignee actor ID; null clears the assignee.

assignee.description: Alias for assignee_id; null clears the assignee.

ResolveRequest.description:
Record a bug resolution. `duplicate_of` is required only when
`resolution` is `duplicate`.

duplicate_of.description: Canonical task ID; required and non-null for duplicate resolution.

note.description: Optional Markdown resolution note recorded as a task comment atomically with the resolution.

ReopenRequest.description: Markdown reason for reopening a resolved bug.

CommentCreateRequest.description:
Either body or text must contain a non-empty value. If both are
supplied and non-empty, body wins; an empty body falls back to text.

text.description: Compatibility alias used when body is empty or omitted.

cursor.description: Opaque stable keyset cursor for this activity item.

color.description: Optional label color; omitted or null uses #94a3b8.

project_ids.description: Non-empty project access ceiling for this agent; empty means any project.
Optional project restriction for this token.

token.description: Plaintext bearer token. Returned only once.

type.description: Event type, for example task.claimed, task.progressed, task.moved, task.completed, bug.triaged, bug.resolved, bug.duplicated, or bug.reopened.

project.description: Project for a project-scoped roadmap; omitted for the global summary.

projects.description: Per-project summaries included in a global roadmap.

state_counts.description: State counts for the requested scope.

upcoming.description: Empty for bearer tokens without tasks:read.

upcoming_tasks.description: Alias of upcoming; empty for bearer tokens without tasks:read.

recent_activity.description: Empty for bearer tokens without events:read.

state_counts.description: Optional per-project state counts; current global roadmap entries omit this field.

TaskClaimUnavailableDetails.description:
Humans and bearer tokens with tasks:read may receive the full current
task or active-claim diagnostics. Bearer tokens without tasks:read
receive only id/version retry metadata for a task conflict, or an
empty object for a column active-claim conflict.

current.description: Full task for humans and tasks:read tokens; reduced id/version metadata for write-only or claim-only tokens.
